jobs.name: flex_precision_gate
cmd:
import pathlib,subprocess,sys,json
out=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
cmd=['timeout','--signal=TERM','--kill-after=30','1560','python3','/content/chat/upload/flex_precision_gate.py','--upload','/content/chat/upload','--manifest-sha256','89f0f62b8812789dd9dd2af3ac479e49511ada120183f3188babb1b11edebd66','--out',str(out)]
p=subprocess.run(cmd)
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(out/'transport_exit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'science_returncode':p.returncode,'transport_only':True})+'\n')
sys.exit(0 if all((out/n).is_file() for n in ['gate_summary.json','out.zip']) else 1)

_comment: Model-only actual L4 BF16. Scientific failure is retained in summary and exit receipt; transport success only permits relay, never scientific PASS or retry-for-pass.
